verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for e-filing integrations, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows only production web filing wizards and an authorized-user UCC e-filing system. Probes found no public API, OpenAPI spec, or any documented sandbox or test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
